name: Coffee
author: Nate Terrence
description: Keep the computer awake on demand: coffee 30m, coffee 5pm, coffee while Firefox

commands.title: Caffeinate or decaffeinate
commands.summary: Keep the computer awake on demand

args.name: action
args.hint: on, off, toggle, status, 30m, 5pm, while Firefox, or schedule

commands.title: Let the computer sleep
commands.summary: Turn off Coffee and restore normal idle and sleep

commands.title: Stay awake for a duration
commands.summary: Caffeinate for a length of time, then stop

args.name: duration
args.hint: 15m, 1h30m, 0:45, or a bare number of minutes

commands.title: Stay awake until a time
commands.summary: Caffeinate until the next time you name

commands.title: Stay awake while an app runs
commands.summary: Caffeinate until a process or window goes away

args.name: app
args.hint: a process or window name, e.g. Firefox

commands.title: Show caffeination status
commands.summary: See what is keeping the computer awake and for how long

commands.title: Manage caffeination schedules
commands.summary: Add, list, pause, resume, or delete a recurring schedule

args.name: action
args.hint: add Mon,Thu 09:00-14:00, list, pause, resume, or delete
